Baptised at Broadwindsor, Dorset, on 15 November 1693, son of Hugh Hutchins; the register spells the name Huchens,
and his brother Benjamin, son of Hugh, was baptised there in 1695.
He crossed to Massachusetts after 1712 and married Sarah Southwick at Salem on 7 January 1720,
then moved inland to Dudley, in Worcester County.
He made his will at Dudley and it was proved at Worcester on 23 April 1745, naming his sons Thomas and Edward and
daughters Sarah, Mary, Hannah and Dorothy; the tree’s death year of 1747 is two years late.
